**Accommodations at Texas Tech K-12**

Texas Tech K-12 provides accommodations for students with disabilities or special needs, both for full-time and part-time/supplemental students. Here’s how the process works:

---

**For Full-Time Students**
- Submit appropriate documentation at the time of enrollment, which may include:
  - A current Section 504 Plan, or
  - The most recent Admission, Review, and Dismissal (ARD)/Individualized Education Program (IEP), along with the most recent evaluation report
- Documentation is reviewed by appropriate personnel.
- A committee meeting may be convened to determine appropriate supports and services in alignment with the online, asynchronous instructional setting.
- Accommodations and services are implemented in accordance with state and federal requirements.

**For Part-Time/Supplemental Students**
- Submit appropriate documentation, which may include:
  - A current Section 504 Plan, or
  - The most recent ARD/IEP, along with the most recent evaluation report
- Accommodation request forms are found in Focus under Forms.
- Documentation will be reviewed, and approved accommodations will be implemented accordingly.

**Important Notes**
- Information about available disability accommodations should be obtained as soon as you enroll in a course or Credit by Exam (CBE).
- Accommodations applied to one course do not automatically apply to other courses. Please specify which courses you are requesting accommodations for.

- Log in to the Focus Portal: [https://ttu.focusschoolsoftware.com/focus/](https://ttu.focusschoolsoftware.com/focus/)
- Go to the Forms section and complete the Accommodation Request Form.
- Submit the required documentation as outlined above.

  - Phone: 1-800-692-6877
  - Email: ttuk12@ttu.edu

---

- Gather your documentation (504 Plan or ARD/IEP) and submit your request through the Focus Portal as soon as possible to ensure timely review and implementation of accommodations. If you need help, reach out to the support contacts above.
